name: Jayco
verdict: Owned by Jayco Australia, founded and owned by businessman Gerry Ryan. Nothing found.
note: Australian caravan/RV maker; co-title sponsor of Liv AlUla Jayco and Team Jayco AlUla. Jayco's own site calls Gerry Ryan its 'founder and owner' (jayco.com.au, 27 Jan 2026); Ryan is also the long-time backer/owner of the GreenEDGE teams (The Inner Ring, 2026-08-05). No state ownership in the chain and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the company found in the sources checked (2026-10-03).
